fusions.name: Greased Vambrace
fusions.desc: A backhand with musk-smeared plate that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Seeps Through Steel
fusions.desc: Vents musk through every joint of your plate, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Musk-Lined Mail
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Wide Berth
fusions.desc: Your armour is 10% higher against enemies carrying your afflictions.
